newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse ends higher, buoyed by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse ends higher, buoyed by Wall Street.

text.p: The Madrid bourse reversed midday losses to end higher on Friday, buoyed by dollar strength and gains on Wall Street and other key stock markets, analysts said.

Dealers said they expected the direction next week to remain linked to external developments, although trade should be more subdued than in previous sessions. * General index rose 1.60 points, 0.26 percent, to 623.17. * Ibex-35 index gained 17.36 points, 0.24 pct, to 7,112.52. * Turnover reaches 82.25 billion pesetas.
"The market is quite calm. Today, the rise abroad and the strength of the dollar lead the way for the market to end higher," one dealer said.
